title: 客户遇到问题很生气，怎样回复才有下一步
topic: 读 Zendesk 的客户投诉邮件范例，练习回应问题、转给负责人并约定更新时间。

source.title: 34 customer service email templates + best practices
source.type: Zendesk 客户投诉邮件范例
paragraphs: Thank you so much for reaching out. I am very sorry you’re experiencing [issue]. It’s completely understandable that you are frustrated. I’ll forward this message to [department] immediately.
We are making this issue a top priority and laying the groundwork to ensure [issue] doesn’t happen again, and I apologize for any inconvenience this caused.
Please reach out with any further questions, comments, or concerns so we can quickly address them.
translations: 非常感谢你联系我们。得知你遇到了[问题]，我很抱歉。你感到沮丧是完全可以理解的。我会立即把这条消息转给[部门]。
我们正在优先处理这个问题，并着手避免[问题]再次发生。对于由此带来的不便，我再次致歉。
如果你还有其他问题、意见或疑虑，请随时告诉我们，我们会尽快处理。
fullTextParagraphs: Customers won’t always be in the honeymoon phase. Eventually, some are bound to complain about a facet of your product or service. Instead of letting that get you down or providing bad customer service, have a prepared response to restore confidence. They took the time to reach out, so make sure you show the same effort in return by remaining polite and patient while working to solve the issue.
Next time you receive a customer complaint, here’s a customer service email template to try out:
Preview: [Customer Name], fixing your issue is our top priority. See details inside.
Thank you so much for reaching out. I am very sorry you’re experiencing [issue]. It’s completely understandable that you are frustrated. I’ll forward this message to [department] immediately.
We are making this issue a top priority and laying the groundwork to ensure [issue] doesn’t happen again, and I apologize for any inconvenience this caused.
Please reach out with any further questions, comments, or concerns so we can quickly address them.
verifiedFacts: Zendesk 的投诉邮件范例先承认客户遇到的问题，再表达歉意。
邮件说明会把问题转给负责团队，并交代后续处理方向。
结尾邀请客户继续补充问题，避免只道歉却没有下一步。

scenario.title: 客户收到的设备无法使用
english: A customer says a new device will not turn on and is upset about the delay.
Acknowledge the issue, send it to the repair team, and give a time for your next update.
chinese: 客户反映新设备无法开机，并对处理延迟感到不满。
回应问题，把情况转给维修团队，并约定下次更新时间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户附上椅子破损的照片；椅子周五前要用于活动，但仓库还没确认能否及时补发。请写一封英文回复：表达理解和歉意、说明你会联系退货团队核实，并承诺今天下午三点前更新进度。
firstAttempt.sample: Hi Jordan, I’m sorry the chair arrived damaged. It’s completely understandable that you’re frustrated, especially with your event coming up. I’ve forwarded the photos to our Returns team, and we’re checking whether a replacement can arrive before Friday. I’ll update you by 3 p.m. today.
firstAttempt.rationale: 承认客户因椅子破损且活动临近而着急，说明已转交退货团队核实补发，并给出明确更新时间。

words.example: I understand why you’re frustrated about the missed delivery.
words.translation: 我理解你为什么会对配送延误感到恼火。

words.collocation: forward a request to a team
words.example: I’ve forwarded your request to our billing team.
words.translation: 我已把你的请求转给账单团队。

words.example: Resolving the access issue is our top priority today.
words.translation: 解决访问问题是我们今天的优先事项。

I’ll forward this to ... immediately 说明下一步由哪个团队跟进。

choice.prompt: 客户收到的设备无法开机，语气很生气。哪条回复更合适？
options: You need to calm down. We are looking into it.
I’m sorry the device isn’t working. I understand how frustrating that is. I’ve sent your case to our repair team and will update you by noon tomorrow.
This is not our department. Please contact someone else.
choice.why: 回应感受，说明负责人和下次更新时间。
